scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -k -n server,widget,cdn,demo -c blue,magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run watch -w widget" "npm run preview -w widget" "vite demo --port 5050 --strictPort"

scripts.docker:publish: docker compose exec server node src/scripts/publish-event.ts
